sharedRules.name: Sneak and Peek
sharedRules.description: A tank with Sneak and Peek can move 10" / 25cm at Tactical if it is not firing its main gun that turn.

sharedRules.name: Milan Mount
sharedRules.description: Milan Missile teams may fire while Mounted as a Passenger in a Warrior (Uparmoured) Transport, using the Passenger Fired Milan Missile weapons line.

sharedRules.name: Swingfire
sharedRules.description: A Team firing Swingfire missiles can remain Gone To Ground while shooting.

sharedRules.name: Radar [Chieftain Marksman]
sharedRules.description: When Shooting at Aircraft, a Chieftain Marksman equipped with Radar does not suffer the usual +1 To Hit penalty for range over 16" / 40cm and extend their range to 40" / 100cm.
